  "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  "email" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "subject" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("subject")
)
